The important parts for THIS feature are: the expo-image-picker plugin (camera + photo permission strings) and the expo-sqlite plugin. iOS needs the NSCamera/NSPhotoLibrary usage strings or the App Store will reject the build and iOS will silently deny the camera.

infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: We use the camera to scan visiting cards and capture enquiry photos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: We access your photos so you can attach reference images to an enquiry.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to use the camera to scan visiting cards.
plugins.photosPermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to access your photos to attach enquiry images.
